In /app/data.hex is the output of hexdump on a binary file. Figure out what kind of file it is, then figure out how to run it, and tell me what the output of that program is.

>     for line in f:
>         line = line.strip()
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         parts = line.split()
>         for p in parts[1:]:
>             val = int(p, 8)

Then investigate the environment for an emulator: check for simh/pdp11/vax/qemu and other relevant binaries. Also dump the first bytes in hex to confirm the a.out header. > lines=open('/app/data.hex').read().split('\n')
> for ln in lines:
>     ln=ln.rstrip()
>     if not ln.strip(): continue
>     parts=ln.split()
>     off=int(parts[0],8)
>     words=parts[1:]
>     recon=''.join('%07o'%(int(w,8)) for w in words)
>     # rebuild bytes
>     b=b''.join(int(w,8).to_bytes(2,'little') for w in words)
>     print(ln)
> EOF
root@11af9af5740e:/app# python3 /app/verify.py | diff - /app/data.hex && echo ROUNDTRIP_OK || echo ROUNDTRIP_FAIL
ROUNDTRIP_OK
root@11af9af5740e:/app# python3 -c "print(' '.join('%02x'%c for c in open('/app/data.bin','rb').read(32)))"
07 01 26 04 1e 00 3c 02 14 01 00 00 00 00 01 00 09 f0 80 11 26 12 d0 0b 36 10 02 00 f7 09 68 00

iE 'sim|pdp|vax|qemu|emu' ; echo '---done'
